arStrings.szText: The Horadrim Cathan, priestess of the Zakarum, wouldn't live to see the atrocities that would be carried out in the name of her religion.
Yet she saw the seeds of darkness sown in her churches and her peers. She wrote of them at length. It never dissuaded her from her prayers.
Cathan was one for whom faith and doubt were partners, not enemies. Her freeness to doubt strengthened her commitment...
...and her faith, her belief that this world can be better, continually pushed her to question how.
This holy memento was hers. “Justice and light,” are etched into the back.
